slots.notes: Navbar wordmark logo to the left of the 'nexto.' text, height 28px. Native asset is an external SVG forced to solid black via filter: brightness(0), so it reads as a single-color glyph tinted to the fg ink.

Full-page layered background image (a spaceship PNG) sized background-size: contain, positioned center 40%, background-attachment: fixed, no-repeat, sitting UNDER a linear-gradient(to top left, #F5F5F5, #F7F7F7) wash. Needs transparency so the gradient page tint shows through around it. Responsive: background-size 90% at <=768px, 100% at <=480px.

Two decorative glyphs flanking the title (native: Google Material Symbols Rounded 'cloud' top-left 42px and 'favorite' bottom-right 32px). Each is gradient-text-filled (#F7B2FB -> #786EF1 -> #5588FB via background-clip:text) with a white drop-shadow outline and a floatSlow bob/rotate loop on staggered delays.

Chevron arrow inside the white 24px circle on the LEFT of the dark 'Let's Connect' gradient pill (and a 32px variant inside the mobile-menu CTA). Native art is an inline chevron SVG; dark stroke on the white circle.

Leading glyphs inside each navigation card's 48px circular #eaecf0 container (native: inline house SVG with white door cutout for 'Main Page', inline circle-dot SVG for 'Showcase'). Single-color line/fill art; container scales 1.05 on card hover.

mechanic: A non-scrolling 100vh flex-column (dashed-border navbar / centered title block with floatSlow-bobbing cloud + heart glyphs / bottom-anchored navigation cards) layered over a fixed gradient-washed spaceship background, with a right-slide full-screen mobile overlay.
techDelivery: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS, with DM Sans and Google Material Symbols Rounded loaded as external fonts and a single floatSlow @keyframes.
reskinNotes: The decorative cloud/heart glyphs, the title-wrapper highlight tags, the CTA pill, and both nav-card icons are gradient/color-baked in CSS and inline SVG rather than driven by the four CSS custom properties, so the accent gradient (#F7B2FB/#786EF1/#5588FB), the dark CTA gradient (#2c2c2c->#111111), the highlight-tag #E0E2E7, and the #eaecf0 icon wells must each be edited by hand to retint. The logo is recolored purely via filter: brightness(0), so a non-black brand mark needs that filter removed. All copy (brand 'nexto.', nav labels, 'Seems you've wandered off...', the 'Whoops! Nothing here yet' title, the subtext with its inline 'chat'/'define' tags, and both card title/subtitle pairs) is hardcoded in markup, and the title letter-spacing -1.5px with clamp() sizing is tuned to DM Sans metrics.
